category: Objects Designed to Store or Record Information
explanation: Scrolls, Microchips, Diaries, and Film Reels are all items designed to store or record information, data, or content. Spectacles (glasses) are used to aid vision, not to store information.

category: Foundational Documents for Individual Rights or Governance
explanation: Magna Carta, Declaration of Independence, US Constitution, and Bill of Rights are all seminal historical documents that established fundamental principles of individual rights, democratic governance, or constitutional law. The Treaty of Versailles, conversely, was a peace treaty signed at the end of World War I, primarily addressing reparations and territorial changes, not establishing foundational legal or governmental frameworks.
Knight (night), Waist (waste), Pair (pear), and Right (write) all have commonly recognized homophones. Left does not have a widely used or common homophone.
